about: Announced openings that are NOT open yet (restaurants, cafés & bars, coffee, bakeries). Shown on the site under New → Opening soon. expectedOpening = YYYY-MM-DD | YYYY-MM | YYYY | "soon"; once that date/period has passed (Europe/Brussels, computed in the browser) the record shows as "Just opened" until it is moved into gent.json (see update.md). Unknown fields are null; nothing invented. `opening: 'YYYY-MM'` is accepted as an alias of expectedOpening. Cards show 'Opening soon · <Month>' (year added beyond the next 3 months); once the month has passed the place shows as 'New since <Month YYYY>' automatically.

upcoming.name: Apero-dance bar at ex-Club 69 (name TBA)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Club 69 closes end of October 2026; the new owners renovate "the whole winter". Nieuwsblad reports a reopening early 2027. New name not yet announced.
upcoming.description: The team behind Café Copain is turning Club 69 into a ticketless cocktail and apero-dance bar where live music turns into dancing.
upcoming.team: Café Copain team (Mathieu Brouillet, Gaetan Jansseune, Ran Knockaert, Jolien Van Robays)

upcoming.name: Sint-Annakerk restaurant & wine bar (Delhaize)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Delhaize, 3 Sep 2026: opening of the shop, restaurant and wine bar "blijft voorzien voor het najaar van 2027"; restoration on schedule.
upcoming.description: The restored 19th-century Sint-Annakerk is being converted into a Delhaize shop with a restaurant and a wine bar under its painted vaults.
upcoming.team: Delhaize (99-year lease); operators of the restaurant and wine bar not announced
upcoming.announcedBy: Delhaize press release, 3 Sep 2026; AVS, 23 Jun 2026

upcoming.name: Lunchbar ROMM
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: AVS: Mirto opens Lunchbar ROMM on 16 November 2026; open Monday to Friday 09:00-15:30.
upcoming.description: Lunch bar in the former Rommelaere Institute by social-economy company Mirto: sandwiches, salads, soup and daily dishes with local, seasonal produce, to eat in or take away; kitchen, bar and service run by people with a distance to the labour market, with coaches.
